security.heroTitle: Discreet protection for those who need it most
security.heroSubtitle: Specialists with military and law enforcement training for personal, corporate, and family protection in high-risk environments.
security.aboutDesc: Our private security team is composed of former military and police officers with years of experience in high-profile protection. We work with clients who require maximum confidentiality: business leaders, public figures, embassies, and family offices.
security.feature1Desc: Agents trained in special forces, weapons handling, tactical driving, and escort protocol.
security.feature2Desc: Prior analysis of the environment, safe routes, and contingency plans for each operation.
security.feature3Desc: Teams available at all times for emergencies or unexpected changes in the itinerary.
security.modality1Desc: Dedicated agent who accompanies the client on all movements with discretion and professionalism.
security.modality2Desc: Multi-agent teams for the protection of families, delegations, or executive groups.
security.modality3Desc: Access control, perimeter management, and VIP protection at corporate, social, or private events.
security.discretionNote: Due to the nature of our service, all information about operations, clients, and procedures is strictly confidential. RZ Group guarantees maximum discretion in every case.
security.ctaSubtitle: Contact us in complete confidentiality. We design a security scheme tailored to your specific needs.

rentACar.heroTitle: Premium SUVs. With or without a driver.
rentACar.heroSubtitle: Premium vehicle rental for corporate, tourism, or personal use in Colombia, the United States, and more destinations.
rentACar.aboutTitle: Flexibility and class in every trip
rentACar.aboutDesc: Our Rent a Car service offers well-maintained premium SUVs, available with a professional driver or for self-drive. Ideal for executives, high-profile tourists, and families who don't want to compromise on comfort during their stay.
rentACar.feature1Desc: Agile and transparent rental process, with coverage included and no hidden charges.
rentACar.feature2Desc: Fleet with rigorous preventive maintenance, detailed cleaning, and inspection before each delivery.
rentACar.feature3Desc: We bring the vehicle to your hotel, airport, or preferred address.
rentACar.fleetSubtitle: Premium SUVs and sedans for any need.
rentACar.option1Desc: Includes a professional driver experienced in handling VIP clients. Ideal if you prefer to focus on your agenda without worrying about navigation.
rentACar.option2Desc: Drive yourself with total freedom. We deliver the vehicle at your preferred location and pick it up when you're done.
rentACar.ctaSubtitle: Available by the day or week. An advisor confirms rate and delivery within 24 hours.

comfortTransport.heroTitle: Comfort and quality for groups of any size
comfortTransport.heroSubtitle: Versatile fleet with professional drivers for corporate, tourism, and group transfers across 6 countries.
comfortTransport.aboutDesc: RZ Group's Comfort Transport is designed for groups, companies, and tourists who seek a professional and safe service without sacrificing comfort. From airport transfers to hourly availability, we adapt to every need.
comfortTransport.feature1Desc: Fleet ranging from 5 to 40 passengers, ideal for corporate groups, events, and tours.
comfortTransport.feature2Desc: Professionals with experience in group transport, road safety training, and customer service.
comfortTransport.feature3Desc: Real-time monitoring and optimized routes to meet every itinerary without setbacks.
comfortTransport.modalityTitle: How do you prefer to travel?
comfortTransport.modalityAirportDesc: Airport pickup and drop-off with real-time flight tracking. Ideal for groups arriving or departing on the same flight.
comfortTransport.modalityHoursDesc: Dedicated driver for your group for 4, 6, 8, or 12 hours. Perfect for tours, events, or workdays.
comfortTransport.ctaSubtitle: Book in under 2 minutes. An advisor confirms availability and capacity within 24 hours.

luxuryTransport.heroSubtitle: State-of-the-art vehicles and professional drivers for an exceptional transfer experience at every destination.
luxuryTransport.aboutTitle: We adapt to the type of service you require
luxuryTransport.aboutDesc: Whether it's an airport transfer, hourly availability within the city, or a service to a tourist attraction. We are a professional team that attends to your requirements promptly and with discretion.
luxuryTransport.feature1Desc: Professionals trained in defensive driving, first aid, and corporate protocol.
luxuryTransport.feature2Desc: Uninterrupted service 365 days a year, adapted to your schedule and time zone.
luxuryTransport.feature3Desc: Ballistic-protection vehicles for clients who require maximum security in their transfers.
luxuryTransport.fleetSubtitle: Select the vehicle that best fits your needs.
luxuryTransport.modalityTitle: How do you prefer to travel?
luxuryTransport.modalityAirportDesc: Airport pickup and drop-off with real-time flight tracking. Includes waiting time at no extra cost for delays.
luxuryTransport.modalityHoursDesc: Dedicated driver for 4, 6, 8, or 12 hours. Ideal for work days, corporate events, or tourism.
luxuryTransport.ctaSubtitle: Book in under 2 minutes. An advisor confirms your service within 24 hours.

airTransport.heroTitle: Fast and exclusive transfers in the air
airTransport.heroSubtitle: Private jets and helicopters for executives, high-profile tourists, and clients who value their time above all.
airTransport.aboutTitle: When time is your most valuable asset
airTransport.aboutDesc: Our Air Transport service connects cities and destinations with discretion and efficiency. We coordinate charter flights in private jets and helicopter transfers for clients who require maximum flexibility, confidentiality, and comfort.
airTransport.feature1Desc: Broad network of aircraft available for domestic and international on-demand flights.
airTransport.feature2Desc: We manage permits, flight slots, ground handling, and connection to VIP ground transport.
airTransport.feature3Desc: Departures at any time of day, tailored to your schedule with no waiting at commercial terminals.
airTransport.option1Desc: Charter flights on executive jets for national and international travel. Maximum privacy, comfort, and punctuality.
airTransport.option2Desc: Short transfers between cities, events, or hard-to-reach areas. Ideal for optimizing time in congested destinations.
airTransport.ctaSubtitle: Tell us your destination and dates. An advisor will confirm availability and rate within 24 hours.
